nodes.summary: The function symbols of the first-order language of groups, graded by arity, are a constant symbol for the identity (arity $0$), a symbol for inversion (arity $1$) and a symbol for multiplication (arity $2$); there are no others.
nodes.title: Group function symbols

nodes.summary: For every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the $n$-ary function symbols of the first-order language of groups are exactly the group function symbols of arity $n$.
nodes.title: The function symbols of the language of groups

nodes.summary: For every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the first-order language of groups has no $n$-ary relation symbols.
nodes.title: The language of groups has no relation symbols

nodes.summary: For every group $G$ and every one-element tuple $(x_0)$ of elements of $G$, the inversion symbol of the language of groups, interpreted in the canonical structure on $G$, sends $(x_0)$ to $x_0^{-1}$.
nodes.title: Inversion in the canonical structure

nodes.summary: For every group $G$ and every pair $(x_0, x_1)$ of elements of $G$, the multiplication symbol of the language of groups, interpreted in the canonical structure on $G$, sends $(x_0, x_1)$ to $x_0 x_1$.
nodes.title: Multiplication in the canonical structure

nodes.summary: For every group $G$, the identity constant symbol of the language of groups, interpreted in the canonical structure on $G$, takes the value $1$ at the empty tuple, where $1$ is the identity of $G$.
nodes.title: The identity in the canonical structure

nodes.summary: For a group $G$, the canonical structure on $G$ for the first-order language of groups interprets the identity constant as the identity $1$ of $G$, inversion as $x \mapsto x^{-1}$ and multiplication as $(x, y) \mapsto xy$; there are no relation symbols to interpret.
nodes.title: The canonical structure on a group

nodes.summary: The first-order language of groups has the group function symbols (a constant for the identity, a unary symbol for inversion and a binary symbol for multiplication) as its function symbols and no relation symbols.
nodes.title: The first-order language of groups

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
